The '''1950–51 Scottish Division A''' was won by [[Hibernian F.C.|Hibernian]] by ten points over nearest rival [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]]. [[Clyde F.C.|Clyde]] and [[Falkirk F.C.|Falkirk]] finished 15th and 16th respectively and were relegated to the [[1951–52 Scottish Division B]].
